Treatment summary
The patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with complaints of low back pain and muscle tightness
across the lumbar region. The reported mechanism is consistent with the injury pattern observed on examination.
Over the course of 29 visits, treatment proceeded along a typical conservative pathway, including manual therapy,
therapeutic exercise, and graded activity instruction. Frequency of visits decreased steadily as symptoms improved
and function returned. Several objective findings, including localized paraspinal tenderness and reduced lumbar
range of motion, support the reported injury, while straight leg raise testing, neurological screening, and reflexes were
within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving the lumbar spine is documented in the available history.
Billing records reflect a single charge for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated entries. At discharge
the patient reported near-complete resolution of symptoms and was released to full, unrestricted activity with a home
exercise program.
